note: Recreation area on 83-acre Sheep Creek Reservoir, ~5 mi S of the Hwy 21/49 junction then 0.5 mi W near Elgin (Grant County water-project area). Primitive tent and RV sites on the reservoir's peninsula, some with electric; boat ramp and two fishing piers. --Claude
